zh: 侧栏品牌标识悬停时不再浮出一块陶土色底板：它此前被列在「发送」按钮这类填充式 CTA 的规则里，靠一条按类名匹配的排除条件才没被填色；排除条件换掉之后，悬停底色落到了品牌按钮上。品牌按钮从这两条规则里移出，它的外观由自己那条规则给全，深色下也不再多出一块底板。
en: The sidebar brand mark no longer floats a clay plate under the pointer: it was listed among the filled CTAs beside the Send button, kept unpainted only by an exclusion written against a host class name, and once that exclusion went the hover fill landed on the brand button. The brand button leaves those two rules; its look comes from its own rule alone, and the dark theme no longer gains a plate either.
